symbolic_theorems: Public emulator: an oracle-free public effective probabilistic program can be externally interpreted with an independent copy of the same public random source, yielding exactly the same terminal-presentation law.

Readout preservation: any public deterministic terminal presentation readout has the same output law after externalization.
